title: Report why an OpenAI Responses generation stopped

files.patch:
@@ -63,6 +63,21 @@ engine: the file chooser relay and the per-turn browser tokens are in the
   `connections.codex`, and the Codex card in Settings shows the machine's
   login instead of a key form. The default stays `:api_key`.
 
+### Fixed
+
+- **OpenAI Responses generations now report why they stopped.**
+  `response.finish_reason` (and `stop_reason`) was `nil` for every Responses
+  generation, streamed or not. It is now `incomplete_details.reason` when the
+  response was cut short (`max_output_tokens`, `content_filter`), else the
+  response's `status` (`completed`).
+
+- **A streamed generation now reports why it stopped.** `response.finish_reason`
+  (and `stop_reason`), and the `finish_reason` of the `prompt.active_agent`
+  event, were `nil` for every streamed Chat and Anthropic generation, since a
+  stream has no response body to read it from. The Chat provider now records
+  the chunk's `finish_reason` and the Anthropic provider the `message_delta`'s
+  `stop_reason`, and the response falls back to it.
+
 ## [1.9.2] - 2026-10-20
 
 Releases `activeagent` and `actionagent` 1.9.2, with the matching browser

+# frozen_string_literal: true
+
+require "test_helper"
+require_relative "../../../lib/active_agent/providers/anthropic_provider"
+
+module Providers
+  module Anthropic
+    # A streamed generation has no response body, so why it stopped has to be
+    # read from the message_delta event and reach the response.
+    class StreamingFinishReasonTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
+      include WebMock::API
+
+      ENDPOINT = "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages"
+
+      def sse(stop_reason)
+        message = { id: "msg_1", type: "message", role: "assistant", model: "claude-sonnet-4-5", content: [],
+                    stop_reason: nil, stop_sequence: nil, usage: { input_tokens: 20, output_tokens: 1 } }
+        events = [
+          [ "message_start", { type: "message_start", message: } ],
+          [ "content_block_start", { type: "content_block_start", index: 0, content_block: { type: "text", text: "" } } ],
+          [ "content_block_delta", { type: "content_block_delta", index: 0, delta: { type: "text_delta", text: "Hello" } } ],
+          [ "content_block_stop", { type: "content_block_stop", index: 0 } ],
+          [ "message_delta", { type: "message_delta", delta: { stop_reason:, stop_sequence: nil }, usage: { output_tokens: 6 } } ],
+          [ "message_stop", { type: "message_stop" } ]
+        ]
+
+        events.map { |name, data| "event: #{name}\ndata: #{data.to_json}\n\n" }.join
+      end
+
+      def stream_prompt(stop_reason)
+        stub_request(:post, ENDPOINT)
+          .to_return(status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type" => "text/event-stream" }, body: sse(stop_reason))
+
+        ActiveAgent::Providers::AnthropicProvider.new(
+          service: "Anthropic",
+          model: "claude-sonnet-4-5",
+          api_key: "test-key",
+          stream: true,
+          messages: [ { role: "user", content: "Hi" } ],
+          stream_broadcaster: ->(_message, _delta, _event_type) { }
+        ).prompt
+      end
+
+      test "a streamed generation reports why it stopped" do
+        assert_equal "end_turn", stream_prompt("end_turn").finish_reason
+      end
+
+      test "a streamed generation cut off at the token limit reports max_tokens" do
+        assert_equal "max_tokens", stream_prompt("max_tokens").stop_reason
+      end
+    end
+  end
+end

+# frozen_string_literal: true
+
+require "test_helper"
+require_relative "../../../../lib/active_agent/providers/open_ai/responses_provider"
+
+module Providers
+  module OpenAI
+    module Responses
+      # The Responses API reports why it stopped as the response's `status`,
+      # plus `incomplete_details.reason` when it was cut short.
+      class FinishReasonTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
+        include WebMock::API
+
+        ENDPOINT = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+
+        MESSAGE = { id: "msg_1", type: "message", role: "assistant", status: "completed",
+                    content: [ { type: "output_text", text: "Hi", annotations: [] } ] }.freeze
+        RESPONSE = { id: "resp_1", object: "response", created_at: 1_761_502_994, model: "gpt-5",
+                     parallel_tool_calls: true, tool_choice: "auto", tools: [], output: [ MESSAGE ],
+                     usage: { input_tokens: 1, output_tokens: 1, total_tokens: 2,
+                              input_tokens_details: { cached_tokens: 0 }, output_tokens_details: { reasoning_tokens: 0 } } }.freeze
+
+        def provider(stream:)
+          ActiveAgent::Providers::OpenAI::ResponsesProvider.new(
+            service: "OpenAI",
+            api_key: "test-key",
+            model: "gpt-5",
+            stream:,
+            messages: [ { role: "user", content: "Hello" } ],
+            stream_broadcaster: ->(_message, _delta, _event_type) { }
+          )
+        end
+
+        def stream_finishing_with(response)
+          type = response[:status] == "incomplete" ? "response.incomplete" : "response.completed"
+          events = [
+            { type: "response.created", response: RESPONSE.merge(status: "in_progress", output: []) },
+            { type: "response.output_item.added", output_index: 0, item: MESSAGE.merge(status: "in_progress", content: []) },
+            { type: "response.output_item.done", output_index: 0, item: MESSAGE },
+            { type:, response: }
+          ]
+          body = events.each_with_index.map { |event, index| "event: #{event[:type]}\ndata: #{event.merge(sequence_number: index).to_json}\n\n" }.join
+          stub_request(:post, ENDPOINT).to_return(status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type" => "text/event-stream" }, body:)
+
+          provider(stream: true).prompt
+        end
+
+        test "a streamed response reports the status it completed with" do
+          assert_equal "completed", stream_finishing_with(RESPONSE.merge(status: "completed")).finish_reason
+        end
+
+        test "a streamed response cut short reports why" do
+          response = RESPONSE.merge(status: "incomplete", incomplete_details: { reason: "max_output_tokens" })
+
+          assert_equal "max_output_tokens", stream_finishing_with(response).finish_reason
+        end
+
+        test "a response that was not streamed reports the status it completed with" do
+          stub_request(:post, ENDPOINT).to_return(
+            status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type" => "application/json" },
+            body: RESPONSE.merge(status: "completed").to_json
+          )
+
+          assert_equal "completed", provider(stream: false).prompt.finish_reason
+        end
+      end
+    end
+  end
+end
